QuestInfo.name: Hillatrooper's Suspicions 4
QuestInfo.0: Another day, another batch of monsters defeated. Speak to #p9390367# to see if there are more.
QuestInfo.1: #p9390367# wants you to eliminate 100 of the #o2100107# population. Go get those monsters!
QuestInfo.2: You finally got rid of all the monsters. At long last, you've proven your worth to #p9390367#. He tells you that #o8860000# and aliens from the #m221000000# are plotting some devious scheme.\r\nGo to #m221000000# and talk to #p2050001# to learn more.

yes.0: You want to know where #o8860000# is headed?
yes.1: This doesn't make us friends, but a promise is a promise.
yes.2: Before the Tournament of Heroes, there was a rumor going around about #o8860000# plotting something with the aliens of #m221000000#.
yes.3: To tell you the truth, that place was pretty much built to hide people. If #o8860000# isn't there, you'll still find some clues.
yes.4: I still have work to do here, so you can go ahead without me. Go talk to #p2050001#. He'll help you out.

mob.0: Can it be? Someone who's about to face down the sorcerer of terror cannot solve a simple riddle?
